_what: A best-guess title for each local subject code with no reliable title (no printed title, no person's save, no derived title at 80 or better), for the Subjects lightning round (#commons/subjects/rapid). A guess is a suggestion: nothing counts as a title until a person accepts it, and an accepted title is that person's save.
method: S737: four reviewers read each code's state-list courses, TOP codes, common subject code and the recommender's top candidate, then web-searched the ones under 80 for the college's own catalog page (Sam: department and program titles often pose as subject titles). A source_says quote comes from a search result's summary; the college sites themselves were out of this session's network reach. Confidence is 0-100, how likely a reviewer accepts the title unchanged; it orders the queue and is not calibrated.
_competition: Sam, 2026-11-26: the four batches compete; the batch whose guesses he edits or skips most often asks the others for tips. batch names which reviewer wrote each guess.
